deffuant.scientific_rationale: Under plus confidence_bound, accepted fraction should increase, homogenize neighborhoods, and lower global opinion variance relative to baseline.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under plus confidence_bound is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, this prediction is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Higher assimilation strength should increase shift magnitudes, accelerate local convergence, and reduce global opinion variance.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under plus assimilation_strength is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, this prediction is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Increasing backfire threshold should reduce repulsive encounters, stabilize network structure, and increase the largest component fraction.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_largest_component_fraction under plus backfire_threshold is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, this prediction is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Reducing confidence_bound should lower accepted encounters, increase local absolute opinion variance, and reduce network opinion assortativity.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_assortativity under minus confidence_bound is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, this prediction is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Lowering backfire threshold should raise backfire frequency, increase local opinion dispersion, and raise global opinion variance.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under minus backfire_threshold is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, this prediction is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Higher assimilation strength should increase variability in opinion shifts, enlarge local shift dispersion, and push the global mean upward under the initial opinion distribution.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_mean under plus assimilation_strength is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, this prediction is falsified.

schelling.scientific_rationale: If the tolerance-to-moving chain holds, increasing tolerance should raise the global moved fraction through district-level relocation dispersion.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global moved fraction does not increase under tolerance plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher tolerance is expected to increase whole-grid same-group neighbour similarity via stronger sorting and reduced boundary mixing.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global spatial neighbour similarity does not increase under tolerance plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher move probability should produce a higher global relocation fraction through increased realized relocation response.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global moved fraction does not increase under move_probability plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Lower move probability is expected to raise global dissatisfaction because fewer unsatisfied agents relocate to better neighbourhoods.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global unhappy fraction does not increase under move_probability minus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher destination preference should increase global spatial neighbour similarity through selective relocation.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global spatial neighbour similarity does not increase under destination_preference plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher destination preference is expected to consolidate same-group clusters, reducing the count of global connected components.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global connected components does not decrease under destination_preference plus.
